claude.note: Claude Code puts a named session's title into the top rule, e.g. '──── CONTROL ALPHA ─' (herdr 0.9.5, Nov 2026). A fresh session shows a suggestion placeholder in the box, e.g. '❯ Try "write a test for <filepath>"'.

codex.note: Real Codex CLI screen (herdr 0.9.5, Nov 2026): no rule lines; the last › row is the input, then the model line and the shortcuts line. Only the verified placeholder counts as empty; any other placeholder refuses (fail closed).
idle_chrome_patterns: ^\s*← for agents · \? for shortcuts(\s{2,}⚠ \d+ warnings? · f2 to view)?\s*$

cursor.note: Real Cursor Agent CLI screen (herdr 0.9.5, Nov 2026): no rule lines; the last → row is the input, then blanks and the status bar.

idle_chrome_patterns: ^\s*>\s+(Auto mode: edits & safe commands auto-approved|Plan mode: research & plan only|Accept-edits mode: file edits auto-approved) \(shift\+tab to cycle\)\s*$

xorc.note: Herdr has no xorc kind; use --tui xorc explicitly
